subject: Social Media
title: Can Virality Be Predicted
description: A quick win: understand Can Virality Be Predicted.

hook.text: Netflix spent millions predicting which shows would be hits. They still funded many flops.

buildup.text: Prediction models look at content features, creator history, timing, and network structure.

discovery.text: Duncan Watts proved that success in cultural markets is inherently unpredictable. Randomness dominates.

twist.text: In his Music Lab experiment, the same song could be a hit or a flop. Social influence determined it.

climax.text: You can increase the odds with Berger's STEPPS. But guaranteed virality remains impossible.

punchline.text: You can build the rocket. You can't control the wind.

quiz.question: What did Duncan Watts' Music Lab experiment prove?
options: Success is inherently unpredictable due to social influence
